note: cold run, 36 bench cases. A planted case is caught when the verdict is blocked or a verified finding sits in a planted file (within ±10 lines of the manifest range when lines are given); the catch is credited to that finding's lens and to the check that verified it (mutation, byte-diff, fail-before-pass-after). When the clean run of the same issue is itself blocked (the agent's change has a verified high finding), a blocked verdict counts only if a non-baseline high finding or a new build/test failure blocks the variant. A test failing on head (passing on base or added by the change) or a head build failure, not also on clean, is credited to 'receipts (build/tests)'. In scope = the manifest's expected_lens for the plant (every planted case for build/tests). For missing-test plants (the plant is a deleted test) a new surviving mutant anywhere counts as the catch. Baseline finding = the clean run of the same issue has the same lens+file finding within 3 lines (mutation survivors: the same mutant text); baseline findings are real findings about the agent's change, never catches or false alarms. False alarm = a non-baseline verified finding AT the planted lines of a control or bait case. Findings elsewhere on a variant are about code identical to clean that the single clean sample did not produce (LLM reviewers vary between runs): reported as off_target in T2, neither catch nor false alarm. Test-quality (mutation) findings are medium severity: they point at the line but do not block. Precision = matching findings / (matching findings + false alarms).
